cues.text: Cataract Falls is on your left. This is a waterfall.

cues.title: Helen Markt Falls
cues.text: Helen Markt Falls is on your right. You will find a bridge on the Cataract Trail. The path crosses Cataract Creek.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: A steady climb starts here. This section is 910 meters long and gains 140 meters.

cues.title: Midway Falls
cues.text: Midway Falls is on your right. After this, the next 730 meters climbs 130 meters.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right on the Cataract Trail. Laurel Dell Falls is on your right.

cues.title: Barths Creek
cues.text: The path crosses Barths Creek. You will find a bridge on the Cataract Trail. Continue straight on the Cataract Trail.

cues.title: Summit
cues.text: A summit is on your left, about 90 meters off the path. After this, the next 560 meters climbs 30 meters.

cues.title: Keep right
cues.text: Keep right on the Cataract Trail. The path on the left is not your route.

cues.title: Cataract Creek
cues.text: The path crosses Cataract Creek. After this, the next 540 meters climbs 20 meters.

cues.title: Cataract Creek
cues.text: The path crosses Cataract Creek. The next 350 meters is mostly level.

cues.title: Cataract Creek
cues.text: The path crosses Cataract Creek. You will find a bridge on the Cataract Trail.

cues.title: Keep left
cues.text: Keep left on the Cataract Trail. The path on the right is not your route.

cues.title: High point
cues.text: This is the highest point of the walk, at about 596 meters.

cues.title: Finish
cues.text: This is the end of the route. The path crosses Cataract Creek.

rows.briefing: This trail is about 1.9 kilometers one way with a total climb of about 80 meters. The steepest sustained climb is 560 meters at about 14% on average. The route culminates at a summit point at 692 meters. Expect a total descent of 90 meters.

cues.title: Start
cues.text: Start the steady climb now. This section is 560 meters long and gains 80 meters in total. You will reach the highest point at 692 meters.

cues.title: High point
cues.text: You have reached the highest point of the walk. This is at about 692 meters.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right onto Benstein Trail. The next 640 meters will drop 40 meters.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right on Benstein Trail. The next 490 meters will drop 30 meters.

cues.title: Finish
cues.text: This is the end of the route.
